description: Opens the slides of an earnings call or other investor event in the chat for the user. Call it when the user asks to open, show or see a presentation, deck or slides ("show me Nvidia's latest earnings slides"). Pass a ticker, with a fiscal period for a past call, or the event id of any investor event. Never call it to read slides yourself: GetInvestorEventSlideMetadata gives a deck's details, and SearchDocuments finds its text.

eventId.description: Investor event id, from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent, for a conference or investor day.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest earnings call with slides.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US. Omit when eventId is given.

name: ShowSlideDeck
title: Show Slide Deck
